about: An attorney at the Seattle, Washington, law firm of Frey Buck, Ted Buck assists clients with general litigation, catastrophic loss and business disputes/planning. Mr. Buck has an exceptional track record in the courtroom and before appellate courts, including successfully representing the City of Seattle in a number of significant cases. He also has obtained numerous multimillion-dollar settlements and verdicts on behalf of his clients in catastrophic loss and subrogation cases. Mr. Buck holds the highest rating possible of AV Preeminent* from Martindale-Hubbell.

From the time Mr. Buck earned a Juris Doctor from the University of Washington School of Law in 1992, he has understood the importance of planning and risk management in business matters. For more than 20 years, he has provided customized guidance and personalized attention to individuals and business owners. He believes the best defense to a number of business-related disputes is good planning. For this reason, he helps his clients develop solutions aimed at avoiding potential problems.

Staying active in both the legal and greater community is a priority for Mr. Buck. He previously served as the president of the Washington Defense Trial Lawyers. Mr. Buck also shares his knowledge with other legal professionals as a frequent presenter at continuing legal education seminars. Mr. Buck also serves on the advisory board of the Salvation Army Northwest Division and the Seattle Police Foundation.

*AV®, BV®, AV Preeminent® and BV Distinguished® are registered certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell Peer Review Ratings fall into two categories – legal ability and general practice standards.
